messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Senior Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Partnerships | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Hires Me Talent Team,

Please consider my attached executive profile for senior opportunities across Saudi Arabia. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with 12+ years across mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

My leadership scope covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, social performance, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications. I also bring exposure to industrial renewable energy, carbon-data governance and multi-agency institutional engagement.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track roles in ESG, sustainability, external affairs, government relations, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, country leadership and responsible business.

I am internationally mobile, available following a 30-day notice period and require employer-supported work authorization. My three-page executive CV is attached for your senior candidate database.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth “Randy” Ramsaroop
